name: Honda - Marysville Auto Plant (MAP) - Marysville OH

fieldNotes.location: Marysville Auto Plant confirmed via satellite + roster address 24000 Honda Parkway. Roster point landed on the SE office cluster; the assembly campus proper is the massive multi-building complex centered ~40.2778,-83.5060.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Major OEM auto assembly plant on a fully secured private campus (Honda Parkway is an internal private road). Controlled truck gates are standard and consistent with the gated road network observed; treated as true with medium confidence on exact lane geometry.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Guarded entry assumed for a high-security auto plant; not individually resolved on Street View (private-road, limited 2021 coverage). Listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yards visible on multiple building faces and standalone lots - many dozens of parked trailers; clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks with trailers backed in along multiple long building faces; 50+ band, count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.railServed: Confirmed - a multi-track rail yard with rail cars runs into the property along the north side (autorack staging).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: assembly plant proper plus logistics/sequencing buildings, paint, stamping and associated structures.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; left false.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity on physically separate building faces (logistics building docks vs main plant docks) supports separate ship/receive.

citations.claim: Honda's own plant page: ~4,600 associates building Accord/Accord Hybrid/Acura Integra at Marysville.
Post-EV-product cancellation Honda continues gas+hybrid production at Marysville; no plant closure.

verification.rationale: Honda self-attested current operation; Mar-2026 EV-product cancellation reallocates the line to ICE/hybrid, plant stays open.
